950-2645-3430-3861.description:
Activate Orzhov Basilica by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Orzhov Basilica
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

339-677-955-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4535-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

277-2557-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1978-5056-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Halflings.
1978-5056-7908.description:
Cause The Notary Hobbits to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5477-5660-6965-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4359-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

2113-4222-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {U}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

140-1824-2530-7350.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
140-1824-2530-7350.notablePrerequisites: You've lost 2 or more life this turn.
140-1824-2530-7350.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Demon's Horn triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat from step 2.

215-4010-6723-7296.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-6723-7296.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

2034-5320-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
2034-5320-6753.description:
Use Ashnod's Altar to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-5320-6753.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Ashnod's Altar, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

1409-1418-5420.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve both Plundering Pirate triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

57-2341-4785-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
57-2341-4785-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

855-2060-2700-2744-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

104-3490-4050-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-6097.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3239-5220-5256-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

413-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
413-5571-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
When the undying creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

252-4785-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-4785-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

198-4067-6072-6281.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Graveshifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Graveshifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Graveshifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

2825-5894.easyPrerequisites: Ready // Willing exiled by Elite Arcanist.
2825-5894.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {6}.
2825-5894.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {6}.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Ready // Willing and casting Ready without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ready, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2741-3490-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2741-3490-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Essence Warden indestructible.
2741-3490-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1741-1912-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
1741-1912-5900.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

56-3220-5256-6248.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-3220-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Phenomenon Investigators and Golgari Germination trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-3220-5256-6248.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

2557-3062-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
2557-3062-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

215-3676-4050-4729-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
215-3676-4050-4729-5176.description:
Cast Myr Enforcer by paying {0}.
Radagast and Tangleroot trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Radagast trigger, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Beast, adding {1}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Myr Enforcer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

618-1494-2646.notablePrerequisites: Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
618-1494-2646.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Sage of Hours that enters the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate the Sage of Hours token by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

539-1987-4423-4637.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three other Islands.
539-1987-4423-4637.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Omnath and Mystic Sanctuary.
Omnath and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, triggering Mystic Sanctuary, Omnath's first ability and Omnath's second ability twice.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve all Omnath triggers, causing you to draw a card, gain four life and add {R}{G}{W}{U}.
Repeat.

1296-1377-1777-1869-1893-2081-2493-3077-.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 13 life.
1296-1377-1777-1869-1893-2081-2493-3077-.description:
Cast Spellseeker, stacking Inalla's trigger under Spellseeker's ETB trigger.
Tutor Culling the Weak to hand with Spellseeker's ability.
Cast Culling the Weak, sacrificing Spellseeker and adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve and pay for the Inalla trigger from earlier, creating a token copy of Spellseeker and leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
When the token ETBs, tutor Unearth to your hand.
Unearth Spellseeker, leaving {B}{B} floating.
Shortcut resolving both Inalla's trigger and Spellseeker's ETB, tutoring for Burnt Offering and Finale of Promise, leaving {B} floating.
Cast Burnt Offering, sacrificing Spellseeker and adding {B}{R}{R}.
Use that mana to cast Finale of Promise with X=1 targeting Unearth and Culling the Weak.
Sacrifice a Spellseeker token to Culling the Weak for {B}{B}{B}{B} and Unearth Spellseeker.
Resolve Spellseeker's ETB and Inalla's trigger, tutoring Entomb and Reanimate into hand.
Entomb and then Reanimate Archaeomancer, leaving {B} floating.
Resolve Archaeomancer's ETB, returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering on Archaeomancer, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger from when Archaeomancer ETB'd and return Reanimate to your hand, leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
Reanimate Archaeomancer and resolve the Inalla trigger, retrieving Burnt Offering and FInale of promise, {B} floating.
Sacrifice Archaeomancer to Burnt Offering, adding {R}{R}{B}{B}.
Cast Finale of Promise with X=1 targeting Entomb and Reanimate.
Entomb Shallow Grave and Reanimate Archaeomancer, {B} floating.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Sacrifice Archaeomancer to Burnt Offering, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, making a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste and leaving {B}{B}{B} floating.
Return Shallow Grave with the token copy's ETB.
Cast Shallow Grave targeting Archaeomancer, leaving {B} floating.
Repeat steps 20-24 for infinite hasty Archaeomancers.

2074-2757-5189.notablePrerequisites:
Vorapede does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a basic land.
2074-2757-5189.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Vorapede, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing Vorapede.
Vorapede's undying ability triggers, returning Vorapede from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Vorapede, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Vorapede, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling token, untapping the basic land.
Repeat from step 2.
